findings.evidence: Roadmap `TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/QuiverRepresentations/Suggested.lean:149-154` declares implicit `{k A}`, arguments `(M) (hM)`, and the explicit conjunction, while `ModuleCat.lean:125-129` declares explicit `(k) (A) (M)` and concludes `Projective P ∧ IsEssentialEpi π`.
findings.fix: Give `exists_projectiveCover` the pinned signature and unpack `exists_essentialEpi_projective` into the explicit conjunction; retain the stronger hypothesis-free result under `exists_essentialEpi_projective`.
findings.issue: `exists_projectiveCover` changes the roadmap target’s arguments and conclusion: it requires explicit `k A`, omits `hM`, and returns `IsEssentialEpi π` instead of the specified `Epi π ∧ ∀ X i, Epi (i ≫ π) → Epi i`, so downstream code written to the pinned API does not typecheck.

summary: The generic bridge and quotient APIs are now exposed, but the roadmap’s named public theorem still does not provide its pinned interface.
